## Logs or screenshots (optional)

For startup or connection problems, include the relevant output from the script or these files under `%APPDATA%\trae-work-skin\`:

- `watcher.log`
- `trae.stdout.log`
- `trae.stderr.log`

Paste short log excerpts in a code block. Screenshots can help with visual problems. Remove tokens and private account, project, code or chat content before sharing.

## Additional context (optional)

Does this happen every time? Did it work with an earlier version or a different material? List any workarounds you tried.
